title: Etale descent of regular intersections and codimension
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], let $n\ge 0$, and let $i_j:D_j\hookrightarrow X$ be closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion] indexed by $j\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. For every finite subset $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $D_J=\mathop{	imes}_{j\in J,X}D_j$ be the iterated scheme-theoretic intersection, with $D_arnothing=X$. Suppose that for every point $x\in X$ and every $J$ there are an étale morphism $v:W	o X$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] and a point $w\in W$ over $x$ such that the local scheme $D_J	imes_X\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{W,w}$ is locally Noetherian and regular (all its local rings are regular local rings), and every irreducible component has codimension $|J|$ in $\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{W,w}$, where codimension is the supremum of lengths of strict chains of irreducible closed subsets. Then every $D_J$ is locally Noetherian and regular, and every irreducible component of $D_J$ has codimension $|J|$ in $X$ (with the same chain-supremum definition).

source.place: Tags 025N (proposition-etale-regular) and 039S (lemma-etale-dimension), together with Tag 02GO (base change of etale morphisms)

proof.text: Fix $J$ and a point $p\in D_J$, and put $A=\mathcal O_{X,p}$, a Noetherian local ring since $X$ is locally Noetherian; let $I\subseteq A$ be the ideal of the closed subscheme $D_J$ (an iterated fibre product of closed immersions over $X$ is a closed immersion: on an affine open $\operatorname{Spec}A'\subseteq X$ where $D_j=\operatorname{Spec}A'/I'_j$, the fibre product is $\operatorname{Spec}A'/\sum_{j\in J}I'_j$), so $\mathcal O_{D_J,p}=A/I$. Choose, from the hypothesis with $x=p$, an étale $v:W\to X$ and $w\in W$ over $p$, and put $B=\mathcal O_{W,w}$. Choosing affine opens $\operatorname{Spec}A'\ni p$ of $X$ and $\operatorname{Spec}B'\subseteq v^{-1}(\operatorname{Spec}A')$ through $w$, the fibre product $D_J\times_X\operatorname{Spec}B'$ is $\operatorname{Spec}B'/I'B'$ with $I'=\sum_{j\in J}I'_j$; hence $w$ lies on the closed subscheme $D_J\times_XW$ of $W$, its local ring there is $B/IB$, and similarly $D_J\times_X\operatorname{Spec}B=\operatorname{Spec}(B/IB)$ with closed point $w$. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-scheme-base-change] the projection $D_J\times_XW\to D_J$ is étale, so flat by [def-weil-etale-morphism], so its stalk map $A/I\to B/IB$ at $w$ is a flat local homomorphism [def-weil-flat-morphism]. The hypothesis says that $D_J\times_X\operatorname{Spec}B$ is regular, so its local ring $B/IB$ at the closed point is a regular (in particular Noetherian) local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme].

source.place: Lemma Tag 02GO (lemma-base-change-etale); the affine description of closed immersions, Lemma Tag 01QO

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-under-regular] to the flat local homomorphism $A/I\to B/IB$ of Noetherian local rings of step 1, whose target is regular: $A/I=\mathcal O_{D_J,p}$ is a regular local ring. Since $p\in D_J$ was arbitrary and $D_J$ is locally Noetherian (a closed subscheme of the locally Noetherian $X$), $D_J$ is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme]. This includes $J=\varnothing$ ($I=0$, so $X$ is regular) and is vacuous when $D_J=\varnothing$. (This is the direction 'B regular implies A regular' of Stacks Tag 025N, whose proof is exactly Tag 00OF.)

source.place: Tag 025N (proposition-etale-regular), first sentence of the proof: 'If B is regular, then A is regular by Algebra, Lemma 00OF'

proof.text: Let $C$ be an irreducible component of $D_J$ [def-weil-irreducible-components] with generic point $\eta$ [def-sc-generic-point]. Apply the hypothesis at $x=\eta$: an étale $v:W\to X$ and $w\in W$ over $\eta$, $R=\mathcal O_{W,w}$, $I\subseteq\mathcal O_{X,\eta}$ the ideal of $D_J$, so that as in step 1 $D_J\times_X\operatorname{Spec}R=\operatorname{Spec}(R/IR)$ and $R/IR=\mathcal O_{D_J\times_XW,w}$. Since $\eta$ has no proper generalization in $D_J$, [lem-sc-scheme-stalk-dimension-generalization-chains] gives $\dim\mathcal O_{D_J,\eta}=0$. The projection $D_J\times_XW\to D_J$ is étale [lem-weil-pbc-etale-scheme-base-change]; on affine opens around $w$ and $\eta$ on which it is given by an étale ring map [def-weil-etale-morphism], [lem-sc-etale-local-dimension] gives $\dim(R/IR)=\dim\mathcal O_{D_J,\eta}=0$. Hence $\operatorname{Spec}(R/IR)$ is the single point $w$, its only irreducible component is $\{w\}=V(\mathfrak m_R)\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}R$, and the hypothesis says that this component has codimension $|J|$ in $\operatorname{Spec}R$. By [lem-sc-scheme-stalk-dimension-generalization-chains] for the closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}R$, this codimension is $\dim R$; so $\dim\mathcal O_{W,w}=|J|$.

Choose affine opens $\operatorname{Spec}A'\subseteq X$ containing $\eta$ and $\operatorname{Spec}B'\subseteq v^{-1}(\operatorname{Spec}A')$ containing $w$ with $A'\to B'$ an étale ring map [def-weil-etale-morphism]; with $\mathfrak q\subset B'$ the prime of $w$ and $\mathfrak p\subset A'$ the prime of $\eta=v(w)$, [lem-sc-etale-local-dimension] gives $\dim\mathcal O_{X,\eta}=\dim A'_{\mathfrak p}=\dim B'_{\mathfrak q}=\dim\mathcal O_{W,w}=|J|$ by step 3. By [lem-sc-scheme-stalk-dimension-generalization-chains], $\dim\mathcal O_{X,\eta}$ is the codimension of $\overline{\{\eta\}}=C$ in $X$, so $C$ has codimension $|J|$ in $X$. Since $C$ was arbitrary, every irreducible component of $D_J$ has codimension $|J|$.

split_report.summary: Audited the imported statement against Stacks etale.tex Tags 025N, 039S, and 02GO. The split has four steps: identify the local rings after base change, descend regularity through the induced étale local map, choose a generic component over each component generic point, and descend its ambient local dimension to obtain codimension. The existing DAG node lem-sc-etale-local-dimension supplies the dimension equality; one new statement-only node records Tag 025N. I checked the empty intersection J=\varnothing and the generic-point codimension argument. Maintainer reader's repair (2026-10-18): the new Tag 025N statement node of the delivery was dropped, since step 2 uses only the descent direction, which is the existing node lem-weil-pbc-flat-under-regular (Tag 00OF) applied to the flat local stalk map; the steps no longer call the stalk maps O_{X,p}->O_{W,w} 'étale' (they are only localizations of étale ring maps) and apply Tag 07QP on affine charts; codimension is written out in the statement and related to local dimension by lem-sc-scheme-stalk-dimension-generalization-chains instead of the Krull-dimension definition.

lean.statement: theorem etale_regular_intersection_descent {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] {n : ℕ} (D : Fin n → Scheme.{u}) (i : (j : Fin n) → D j ⟶ X) (hclosed : ∀ j : Fin n, IsClosedImmersion (i j)) (hlocal : ∀ (x : X) (J : Finset (Fin n)), ∃ (W : Scheme.{u}) (v : W ⟶ X) (w : W), Etale v ∧ v w = x ∧ let P : Scheme.{u} := localIntersection D i J W v w IsLocallyNoetherian P ∧ (∀ z : P, IsRegularLocalRing (P.presheaf.stalk z)) ∧ (∀ z : P, closure ({z} : Set P) ∈ irreducibleComponents P → Order.coheight (localIntersectionProjection D i J W v w z) = (J.card : ℕ∞))) : ∀ J : Finset (Fin n), IsLocallyNoetherian (intersectionScheme D i J) ∧ (∀ z : intersectionScheme D i J, IsRegularLocalRing ((intersectionScheme D i J).presheaf.stalk z)) ∧ (∀ z : intersectionScheme D i J, closure ({z} : Set (intersectionScheme D i J)) ∈ irreducibleComponents (intersectionScheme D i J) → Order.coheight (intersectionMap D i J z) = (J.card : ℕ∞))

statement_change.old_statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], let $D_1,\ldots,D_n\hookrightarrow X$ be closed subschemes [def-weil-closed-immersion], and for $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ write $D_J=\mathop{\times}_{j\in J,X}D_j$ for the scheme-theoretic intersection (with $D_\varnothing=X$). Suppose that for every point $x\in X$ and every $J$ there are an étale morphism $v:W\to X$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] and a point $w\in W$ over $x$ such that, with $R=\mathcal O_{W,w}$, the local scheme $D_J\times_X\operatorname{Spec}R$ is regular and every irreducible component of it has codimension $|J|$ in $\operatorname{Spec}R$. Then every $D_J$ is regular and every irreducible component [def-weil-irreducible-components] of $D_J$ has codimension $|J|$ in $X$. Here the codimension of an irreducible closed subset $Z$ of a scheme $Y$ is the supremum of the lengths $n$ of chains $Z=Z_0\subsetneq Z_1\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq Z_n$ of irreducible closed subsets of $Y$.

citers.note: It applies the result to a finite boundary family and includes the empty intersection; the explicit Fin-indexed formulation preserves that use.

statement_change.what: The original statement did not introduce the integer n and the indexed closed immersions as Lean objects, did not specify how the finite intersections are constructed, and left the regularity and codimension predicates ambiguous for the local Spec of a stalk. The correction makes the Fin-indexed family, every Finset including the empty one, the iterated pullback construction, stalkwise regularity, and chain codimension explicit.
